text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even after our meeting ended, Neo Universe showed no sign of moving...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Before reaching the critical point.
Even so, just a little longer here...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe seems to be exhausted
from running races in close succession.
Let's adjust her upcoming schedule.
